http_campaign.latency_note: Curl process, proxy, TLS, Cloudflare and network round-trip included; not isolated backend service time.

limitations: Synthetic uniformly distributed movie aliases; zero AniDB/episode rows.
OS page cache is not dropped; no-index means missing Tantivy index, not cold disk.
No public network import; missing-metadata sources fail at a loopback refused port.
Readiness is polled concurrently; discovery precision is limited by poll and request scheduling.
Peak RSS is Linux VmHWM sampled every 5ms through the request probes.
Same-title warm requests exercise caches, not distinct-title throughput.
The first match runs after parser probes, so its parser cache is already warm.

match_first.source: Final follow-up binary; same startup code, matching safety fixes included.

primary_remote.metric_scope: Only explicitly labeled cases with both expected identifier endpoints. Reference, partial and unknown expectations are excluded. Recall includes unavailable labeled positive cases; precision excludes them.

root_exact_title_assertions.scope: Biased difficult regression cohort; not population title accuracy.

matcher.scope: Source expectation agreement. P345 corroborates identity references, not intent or episode numbering. Yearless Supernatural is intentionally ambiguous; ASIDs absent from labels are unscored.
